page.notes: The woodcut diagram occupies the upper part of the page and is not transcribed as text; its labels (HELICE, CANOPVS, F, and the degree numbers) are printed within the figure. The Greek word on the first line reads as printed but is only partly legible ("ϰυρτόττα" as best read), so it is marked as doubtful: ϰυρτότητα [?]. The final word "in" at the end of the last line is printed alone at the right and may be the start of the next line's catchword position; it is kept as the last line of text. No page number or running head is visible on this scan.
